description: Celda clonada de asignacion 553309 con tooltip de timeline centrado debajo
pre_capture_js: (() => { const original = document.querySelector('otto-web-date-cell:has([data-qa-name="553309"])'); const tip = document.querySelector('gs-tooltip:has(otto-web-assignments-timeline-tooltip)'); if (original) { const rect = original.getBoundingClientRect(); const clone = original.cloneNode(true); clone.setAttribute('data-capture-cell', 'o8-imagen3'); clone.style.position = 'fixed'; clone.style.left = '120px'; clone.style.top = '16px'; clone.style.width = `${Math.round(rect.width)}px`; clone.style.height = `${Math.round(rect.height)}px`; clone.style.zIndex = '9998'; clone.style.display = 'block'; clone.style.background = 'var(--color-grey-lighter)'; const root = document.querySelector('otto-web-root'); if (root) root.style.visibility = 'hidden'; document.body.appendChild(clone); if (tip) { const cloneRect = clone.getBoundingClientRect(); const pane = tip.closest('.cdk-overlay-pane'); const box = tip.closest('.cdk-overlay-connected-position-bounding-box') || pane; if (pane) { pane.style.position = 'fixed'; pane.style.left = `${Math.round(cloneRect.left + cloneRect.width / 2)}px`; pane.style.top = `${Math.round(cloneRect.bottom + 12)}px`; pane.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; pane.style.zIndex = '9999'; pane.style.visibility = 'visible'; } if (box && box !== pane) { box.style.position = 'fixed'; box.style.left = '0px'; box.style.top = '0px'; box.style.width = '100vw'; box.style.height = '100vh'; box.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; box.style.visibility = 'visible'; } } const backdrop = document.querySelector('.cdk-overlay-backdrop'); if (backdrop) backdrop.remove(); } })();
